events.text: New plan for Alex: lose goal, $50/week, 3 meals a day. Doctor first.
Reading guidelines.json for the rules that apply
DGA floors and caps: at least 1500 kcal, under 2300 mg sodium, 29 g fiber.

reasons.why: About 14 g of fiber per 1,000 kcal supports digestion, fullness and heart health.
Added sugar under 10% of calories leaves room for nutrient dense food.
Sodium under 2,300 mg a day lowers the risk of high blood pressure.
Saturated fat under 10% of calories protects your heart.
Eating below this floor makes it hard to get enough nutrients and is not safe without medical supervision.
reasons.source: NIH NHLBI, Aim for a Healthy Weight: low calorie diets (https://www.nhlbi.nih.gov/health/educational/lose_wt/eat/calories.htm)

reasons.why: Foods you are allergic to are removed in code before any meal is planned.

constraints.summary: Alex's plan rules: At least 1500 kcal and 29 g fiber a day, under 2300 mg sodium, under 52 g added sugar, saturated fat under 10% of calories. Never: peanut.

events.text: Allergy and restriction filter active: no peanut. Excluded tags: peanut.
Opening the recipe book and scoring every dish for Alex
I have 33 ideas: chicken, mexican, rice bowls with real variety. Let me cook!
Chicken breast, roasted alone eats $8.80 of the $50 across the pool. Lovely, so is rent. Once a week?
Fine, I keep chicken breast once and lean on beans and eggs for the rest. Flavor stays.
Pool reviewed: no idea breaks a per meal cap at its smallest portion. Approved.
First solve: budget and protein are the scarce resources (budget binding at $50; protein 23 g under target on 7 days). Chef: 6 new meals.

events.text: Second solve used 4 of Chef's 6 new meals; protein deviation went from 23 g to 6 g. Solved in 6.1 s.
Re-checking every hard rule on the final plan
All seven days pass every rule. I am satisfied.
Budget is the binding constraint: $49.90 of your $50 is working. Every extra dollar buys variety.
I will watch weight, glucose and logs daily and replan when the trend says so.
Plan v1 approved: 7 days, $49.90, zero rule violations.
